text: USA hasn't lost a FIBA Women's World Cup game since September 2006. Nine players on this 2026 roster have never been to one. They open Friday vs. China in Berlin. — USA TODAY
thread: The newcomers include Aliyah Boston, Paige Bueckers, Caitlin Clark, Angel Reese and six others. Breanna Stewart joins Sue Bird and Diana Taurasi as the only US women with four World Cup appearances.
All 36 games stream on HBO Max; 17 air on TNT and truTV, including every U.S. game.
